statement: In each of the three published 285-edge girth-5 graphs on 74 vertices, freeing the edges at any 1 or 2 vertices and re-adding edges there cannot reach 286 edges with girth at least 5.
scope: Only these three graphs (graph6 sha256 e162f519..., a728d778..., b569fc77...; lines 148-150 of n74.g6 in iter2DownXtra_150.zip from github.com/AGT-Kulak/searchMaxSizeMinGirth) and only reroutings of 1 or 2 vertices. Says nothing about 286 edges in general.

slow_recheck: d=$(mktemp -d) && curl -sL -o $d/g.zip https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AGT-Kulak/searchMaxSizeMinGirth/main/resultGraphs/iter2DownXtra_150.zip && unzip -q $d/g.zip -d $d && for L in 148 149 150; do go run ./cmd/wb girth5-reroute -k 2 -line $L -out $d/runs $d/iter2DownXtra_150/n74.g6 | grep -q ': 2701 UNSAT with checked proofs, 0 SAT, 0 errors' || exit 1; done

literature.best_published: ex(74; {C3, C4}) >= 285 (Goedgebeur, Jooken, Joret, Van den Eede, arXiv 2508.05562v2, Sep 2026)
literature.notes: A scoped search result, not a bound. Each of the 3 x 2701 cases was UNSAT with a text LRAT proof accepted by both cmd/check-lrat and cake_lpr (formally verified), rerun 2026-11-25. k = 1 is implied by k = 2 (freeing more edges only adds options).
